## Checklist

- [ ] The repository's full check passes (usually `pnpm verify`)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) and signed
- [ ] New behavior has tests; a bug fix has a regression test
- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit (`feat:`, `fix:`, `!` for a breaking change): the release notes and version come from it
- [ ] Visual or docs changes follow m3l-design (tokens, components, content conventions)
